name: OUTCOMES_CORE_V3
about: OUTCOMES_CORE_V2 labels for event_outcomes code VERSION 3 (A51 successor). V1 and V2 stay as run (never edited); they are refused by VERSION 3 because their MONEY_T1 is the retired static-cost kind 'money'.
changes: A51-06: MONEY_T1 is kind money_full: EXIT_T1 after the factory's full cost of record (factory_v2 trade_cost: costs V3_5 fee + book + gap + funding on the entry notional, size 10,000 USD as the cost settings). A trade whose funding is missing is EMPTY (FUNDING_MISSING); its fee + book + gap stay in MONEY_T1__<dir>__cost_prefunding. The V1/V2 MONEY_T1 (exit minus static V1 cost + gap, no funding) is not money of record and is not carried.

A51-06 / B1 / C3: the static cost table is pinned by sha16 and its median fallback is named: fallback 'unknown' makes a c-unit label of a coin missing from the table EMPTY (NO_UNIT:COST_FALLBACK) instead of a median guess; unit__c_fallback flags it.

A51-04: the V2 run_window (documentary) is removed from this yardstick: the caller's authorized outcome window is a RUN argument (--run-window FIRST:LAST, or a run_window key in a run's own settings), ENFORCED before any read (selection inside it; every label whose window could need a bar at or after its end is EMBARGO_SUPPORT, its row kept). The code holds no date.
A51-05 / A51-07: exits go through exit_engine.run_frozen (frozen registry row, schema, cost table, module and the run's transitive inventory); the exits path is relative to the forensics folder.
A51-01 / A51-02: every horizon is a whole number of 3 s bars (unchanged values: 5, 15, 60, 240, 300 min); gap_s stays 60 (LABEL_EWSD convention through label_ewsd_v2.path_first_gap).

entry.why: the factory's entry: taker at the first 3 s bar ending at or after F + 6 s (+ one bar), within 60 s
entry.gap_why: LABEL_EWSD_V2's gap (label_ewsd_v2.path_first_gap): a stretch longer than 60 s without a valid bar is a data hole

cost.why: labcore.costs cost_c: the static cost of record for the unit c (label c = gate c = exit c) and the exit engine's frozen cost table

money.why: the factory's money of record (factory_v2.costs_of / trade_cost, costs V3_5), the size the cost settings price

units_note: nm = the coin's normal 15 min move (median absolute 15-minute log move over 24 h ending 1 h before the alarm, log-pct), stored only in EPI.A02N (A02 family). An event without its EPI.A02N row is EMPTY (NO_UNIT:<why>), never a default.

labels.name: MONEY_T1
labels.why: THE yardstick: EXIT_T1 after the factory's full cost of record (fee + book + gap + funding); complete funding and a CLEAN path only

labels.name: EXIT_T1
labels.why: the booked exit before cost (CLEAN path only; the booking in __booked), what closed it, its evidence and holes

labels.name: BEST_60M
labels.why: best move in units of the coin's cost

labels.name: REACH_4C_240M
labels.why: LABEL_EWSD's offer 4c over its 4 h hold
